fact: Le Soleil reports that Senegal's social programmes (Bourses de securite familiale, CSU, Carte d'egalite des chances, Fonds de solidarite nationale, RNU) run on separately developed information systems that limit data exchange, with a workshop of 23-24 July 2026 opened to design an interoperable system.

The World Bank status report says vulnerable households registered to the RNU by the DGPSN will be targeted for free ReadyBoard connections under the energy access project, with connections expected to begin in early 2027; none connected by 4 December 2025.

The World Bank's US$100m Adaptive Safety Net Project, approved in 2022, funds modernisation of the RNU management information system covering controlled data sharing and interoperability with other social protection systems, and a PNBSF beneficiary-management system that draws its targeting from the RNU.

The minister of Family, Social Action and Solidarities said at a workshop in Saly that each structure in the social sector has its own information system, which does not always allow data to be shared with other actors, and that a unified system is still to be built ahead of a planned single social window.
system: Social protection information systems of the structures in the social sector
